name: Duloxetine
effects: Reduces depressive, anxious, and neuropathic/musculoskeletal pain symptoms
Approved for fibromyalgia, diabetic peripheral neuropathy, chronic musculoskeletal pain
Nausea (most common), dry mouth, constipation, hyperhidrosis
Hepatotoxicity risk — avoid in significant alcohol use or liver disease
Discontinuation syndrome on abrupt stop — taper recommended
Risk of serotonin syndrome with other serotonergic agents

halfLifeEvidence.quote: Duloxetine has an elimination half-life of about 12 hours (range 8 to 17 hours)
